text: Provides a local desktop API that runs fully offline on localhost
quote: Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost. It operates fully offline

text: Offers an official CLI to run Anytype headlessly for automation and scripting
quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.

text: Lets AI assistants interact with the API using natural language
quote: enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.

text: API supports creating chats, sending/streaming messages, reacting, and searching chat history
quote: Create chats, send and stream messages, react, and search chat history (anytype-heart v0.50.7)

text: Agents can run scripts against your data to handle bulk edits and repetitive tasks
quote: the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data — programmatically — to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks

text: Can back up channels and data to a self-hosted network via custom network configuration
quote: To back up your channels and data to a self-hosted network, you need to have a network configuration.

text: Local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node so sync only happens over the local network
quote: you can enable local-only mode. This mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely

text: Queries let you define criteria once and get an always-up-to-date live view of matching objects
quote: A Query is a question you ask your knowledge base—answered instantly and kept up to date automatically.

text: The Graph gives a live visual map of every object in a channel and how they connect
quote: The Graph is a live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect to each other.

text: Web Publishing turns any object into a public webpage with a static HTML page on your own subdomain
quote: Pick an Object, click Publish, and Anytype generates a static HTML page hosted on your personal subdomain at .any.org/

text: Custom ANY ID gives you a unique handle used for web publishing URLs
quote: Include a custom ANY ID — your unique handle, used for web publishing URLs

text: You can choose export/import format between Markdown or Any-Block
quote: Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.

text: Supports collaboration with others while preserving privacy
quote: Anytype lets you collaborate with others without sacrificing your privacy.

text: Templates are saved, reusable page layouts you can apply to new objects
quote: A Template is a saved layout for a page that you can reuse.

text: Importing a folder of Markdown files auto-creates a separate object for each file
quote: Anytype will process the contents and automatically create a separate object for each Markdown file.

text: Provides an MCP toolkit letting AI assistants safely read, search, and modify your Objects
quote: an open-source toolkit that gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects in your Anytype Channels

text: Ships an official Docker image maintained by the Anytype team for self-hosting
quote: There's also a docker image that's maintained by the team.

text: You can import content into spaces and export it at any time
quote: You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.

text: Your vault is encrypted and access is controlled entirely by you — not even Anytype can see your content
quote: Only you can access your spaces and grant access to others — not even Anytype can see your content.

text: All content is stored locally, giving a fully offline-first experience
quote: All your content is stored locally on your device... This means an offline-first experience: the app always works without an internet connection

text: Built-in Types can be extended with your own custom Types
quote: Anytype comes with built-in Types, but you can create your own custom Types to match your needs.

text: Collaborators can join without providing an email, buying a subscription, or requesting permission
quote: Collaborators don't need to provide an email address, buy a subscription, or ask anyone for permission.

text: Can import Obsidian vaults directly through Channel Settings → Import
quote: Open Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian and click on Import files.

text: Agent-capable tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot) can run scripts against your Anytype data
quote: Drop it into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, or any other agent-capable tool, and the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data

text: Supports peer-to-peer sync or self-hosting on your own network for collaboration
quote: You can even collaborate directly with others using peer-to-peer sync or self-host on your own network.

text: Linking objects turns separate notes into a connected knowledge base
quote: Linking on Anytype is what turns a bunch of separate notes into a connected knowledge base.

text: Vendor infrastructure automatically handles background syncing and backups across devices
quote: Our infrastructure handles background syncing and backups automatically, so you retain full ownership of your data without compromising your sovereignty.

text: A Vault is an encrypted local container that stores everything you create directly on your device
quote: A Vault is an encrypted container in Anytype that you own. Everything you create lives inside your Vault, stored directly on your device.

text: API endpoints cover core functionality: creating, editing, and querying objects
quote: Endpoints offer core Anytype functionality: creating objects, editing, querying and much more.

text: OpenAPI spec is converted into MCP tools so you can manage your knowledge base through conversation
quote: converting Anytype's OpenAPI specification into MCP tools, allowing you to manage your knowledge base through conversation.

text: API docs cover querying, retrieving, and updating spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates
quote: Learn how to query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build powerful extensions.

text: No email or password requirement makes Anytype offline-first and decentralized
quote: Not requiring an email and password is what makes Anytype offline-first and decentralized.

text: Composable blocks include text, databases, kanban, calendar, and custom Types
quote: Composable blocks: text, databases, kanban, calendar & custom Types.

text: Extensible via a gRPC API and AI 'Agents' as documented in AGENTS.md
quote: Extensible through a gRPC API and AI "Agents" (see AGENTS.md).

text: Your Key is a permanent 12-word recovery phrase that can never be changed or reset
quote: Your Key is a 12-word phrase that can never be changed or reset.
